The immediate odor issue and the normative question about future ventilation were settled through that conditional agreement and practical assistance.

Arjun introduced the complaint and persisted until a conditional agreement and practical backup were obtained; he did not change position but secured cooperation.
Michelle and John did not present or change positions related to the ventilation dispute; they took independent, nonconflicting actions (labeling utensils, using stove).

substantive_insights: Tension: ventilating to clear cooking smell versus risk of wetting laundry from rain-facing window.
Resolution used a conditional agreement plus an explicit backup (Arjun will move laundry), which balances both parties' practical interests.
Shared-usage hygiene (washing shared utensils) was addressed through explicit action rather than dispute.
